output.reason: Two days of black tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing in a 58-year-old suggests upper GI bleeding with possible volume loss, requiring immediate emergency assessment, labs and endoscopy capability that messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Black, tarry stools with feeling lightheaded on standing can mean active bleeding in your stomach or intestine and needs urgent blood tests and a camera exam today. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself; call 911 instead if you faint, vomit blood, or feel confused or very weak.
